source.name: MLB.com - 'This is real': A's unveil Las Vegas jersey patch for 2025 season
source.note: The club's own announcement of a three-year, all-jersey deal, so it covers this season. The patch is worn on the sleeve; the record keeps the repo's 'patch' placement, as the other MLB kits do.
source.quote: Debuting on Opening Day, March 27 against the Mariners at T-Mobile Park, the A's will wear the "Las Vegas" patch on their sleeve

summary: Jersey patch: Las Vegas Convention and Visitors Authority (LVCVA) - 'Las Vegas' patch.
